_comment: Card text verified against limitlesstcg.com. `sim` holds the fields the engine reads; everything else drives the deck builder UI.

_schema.max: copy limit; basic Energy is unlimited (null)
_schema.sim: engine-relevant mechanics; omit if the card is flavour only

cards.name: Mega Darkrai ex
cards.text: Dusk Raid [D][D] 110+ — if your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 110 more damage. Abyss Eye [D][D][D] — if your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, it is Knocked Out.

cards.name: Mega Absol ex
cards.text: Terminal Period [D][C] — if your opponent's Active Pokémon has exactly 6 damage counters on it, that Pokémon is Knocked Out. Claw of Darkness [D][D][C] 200 — your opponent reveals their hand and you discard a card you find there.

cards.name: Fezandipiti ex
cards.text: Ability: Adrena-Brain — once during your turn, if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 3 cards.

cards.name: Munkidori
cards.text: Ability: Adrena-Brain — once during your turn, if you have a Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon, you may move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Darkness Energy
cards.text: Provides [D] Energy.

cards.name: Spiky Energy
cards.text: Provides [C] Energy. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack (even if Knocked Out), put 2 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Ultra Ball
cards.text: Discard 2 cards from your hand, then search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Dark Bell
cards.text: Both Active non-[D] Pokémon are now Confused.

cards.name: Night Stretcher
cards.text: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Energy Search
cards.text: Search your deck for a Basic Energy card, reveal it and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Energy Retrieval
cards.text: Put 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Energy Switch
cards.text: Move a Basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Switch
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench.

cards.name: Crushing Hammer
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Punk Helmet
cards.text: If the [D] Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack (even if Knocked Out), place 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Powerglass
cards.text: At the end of your turn (after your attack), if the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to it.

cards.name: Amulet of Hope
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an attack, search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand.

cards.name: Air Balloon
cards.text: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is [C][C] less.

cards.name: Lillie's Determination
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.

cards.name: Judge
cards.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck, then draws 4 cards.

cards.name: Jett
cards.text: Draw a card for each of your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Petrel
cards.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Boss's Orders
cards.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

cards.name: Janine's Secret Art
cards.text: Choose up to 2 of your [D] Pokémon. For each, search your deck for a Basic [D] Energy card and attach it. If you attached Energy to your Active Pokémon this way, it is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Black Belt's Training
cards.text: During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 40 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon ex.

cards.name: Lisia's Appeal
cards.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, the new Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.name: AZ's Tranquility
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you moved a Pokémon ex to your Bench this way, heal 80 damage from that Pokémon.
